title: Nelson Tasman — Nelson City travel guide

facts.fact: Nelson is at the northern end of New Zealand South Island on Tasman Bay; city is distinguished from Nelson elsewhere.
facts.excerpt: top of New Zealand’s South Island

facts.fact: Central Nelson is walkable, with local bus options for places further out; no fare invented.
Centre of New Zealand is a historic survey landmark, explicitly not the exact geographic centre.
Regional guide says the city no longer has a traditional isite; advice is not sent to a nonexistent former visitor office.
facts.excerpt: doesn’t have a traditional isite anymore
